title: PrivacyPolicy
description: Shared schema module for reusable privacy classes and sensitive-data handling semantics referenced by multiple root contracts.

PrivacyClass.description: Privacy classification assigned to a variable for data protection policy.

VoiceInputPolicy.description: Whether voice input is forbidden, optional, or recommended for this field.

ReadbackPolicy.description: Whether the system may read back the entered value: never, only with user opt-in, or always.

SilentInputFallback.description: Preferred silent input method when voice is not used.

SensitiveDataPolicy.description: Policy for handling sensitive data input and output (voice, readback, silent fallback). If omitted, runtimes MUST apply the privacyClass defaults documented in model.md section 7.

voiceInputPolicy.description: Default: 'recommended' for public/personal, 'optional' for sensitive, 'forbidden' for secret.

readbackPolicy.description: Default: 'always' for public/personal, 'optInRequired' for sensitive, 'never' for secret.
